node: Hidden auto OEM supplier dependency and pricing-stress chokepoints
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around auto OEM supplier-dependency stress, with Ford used as the reference anchor and the discovery lane focused on scarce or substitute suppliers exposed to aluminum body sheet, driveline/metal-forming platforms, and aftermarket parts disruption. The strongest underfollowed leads are not broad auto OEMs, but component/material suppliers where a single plant, customer concentration, platform sourcing, or distressed competitor collapse could shift volume, pricing, or consolidation value. Claims are early-funnel only and require filings, purchase commitments, receivables, customer concentration, plant-level activity, and customer confirmation before promotion.
